caption: A bowl of spicy ramen broth, rich and red, steams invitingly. Topped with bean sprouts, green onions, and dried chilies, it sits in a white bowl on a dark wooden table, lit warmly from above.

segments_info.text: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle sheen under ambient lighting.
The spicy broth is vibrant red, glossy, and thick, swirling around tender noodles and garnished with bean sprouts, green onions, and dried chili.
White ceramic bowl with smooth, glossy surface and slightly raised, rounded rim.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved, rounded tip.
